sourceWindows: CURRENT / ADJACENT: Pitchfork's 2026 reviews of Placid Angles — Canada and Nathan Fake — Evaporator supplied exact routes through assertive breakbeats with slowed surroundings, beat-to-string yielding, restless rhythm with a vocal center, cyclical expansion and limited acoustic/dissonant stretch. https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/placid-angles-canada https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/nathan-fake-evaporator

CURRENT / EMERGING-LABEL WINDOW: Pitchfork's 2026 Flying Lotus — BIG MAMA review and Brainfeeder release supplied miniature trap-to-jazz, drone-to-club-boom and build/self-implosion constructions while preserving the review's contrary evidence about underdevelopment. https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/flying-lotus-big-mama

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE: the same Placid Angles and Nathan Fake sources were followed backward through The Cry, First Blue Sky, Touch the Earth, Outhouse and Drowning in a Sea of Love; only the current exact tracks with sufficiently concrete evidence survived this request.

FRESHNESS CHECK: repository searches found no durable decision, revisit or utility entry for the nine requested exact artist-title identities. Flying Lotus — Antelope Onigiri was excluded as a prior resolved alternate. Runs 125–130 selected ecosystems were not recycled.
exclusions: Canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits, existing utility discoveries and unresolved prior leads without materially new identity evidence were excluded.

Runs 125–130 selected ecosystems were not retried: Black Bananas, Djrum, Rrose, Ripatti, Nondi_, Beatrice Dillon, Lechuga Zafiro, Skee Mask, Verraco, Jump Source, Rian Treanor/Ocen James, DJ Cinéma Quartier Latin, Silvan Strauss, Gloorp, Rival Consoles, Pev, Björk, Marina Herlop, Kali Malone, Daphni, Dolo Percussion, Matryoshka, Safety Trance, Foodman, username/Marsh crane and Ibrahim Alfa Jnr.

Flying Lotus — Antelope Onigiri was excluded because it already resolved as an unevaluated alternate in Run 118. Release-only atmosphere, prestige and genre labels without a concrete structural route were excluded.
No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
